integrity: Exact algebraic coefficients and positive normal hyperbolicity are proved analytically. Numerical integrations check illustrative finite perturbations but are not substituted for the singular-limit proof.
limitations: Deterministic susceptible-resource, mutually exclusive two-strain model. Perturb each phenotype by common proportional scaling of both stage-transmission rates. Uniform finite slow-time intervals only; no all-time error bound or stochastic prediction.
title: A generation-time-weighted slow selection law at a virulence fitness tie
